title: Pi-hole Weekly
description: Weekly DNS digest from Pi-hole's long-term database: blocking, new sites, devices, encrypted-DNS bypass and LAN lookups leaking upstream.

list.name: week
list.label: Week
list.query:
SELECT 'last' AS __value, 'Last full week (' || (SELECT label FROM weeks WHERE complete = 1 ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT 1) || ')' AS __text
UNION ALL SELECT 'current', 'This week so far'
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT week_start, label FROM weeks ORDER BY week_start DESC)

panels.title: Queries
panels.description: Every DNS query Pi-hole answered this week, and the change against the week before.

targets.queryText:
WITH sel AS (SELECT (SELECT CASE '$week' WHEN 'last' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks WHERE complete = 1) WHEN 'current' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks) ELSE '$week' END) AS wk)
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', w.week_start) AS INTEGER) AS time, w.queries AS "Queries"
FROM weeks w, sel WHERE w.week_start IN (sel.wk, date(sel.wk, '-7 days')) ORDER BY w.week_start
targets.rawQueryText:
WITH sel AS (SELECT (SELECT CASE '$week' WHEN 'last' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks WHERE complete = 1) WHEN 'current' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks) ELSE '$week' END) AS wk)

FROM weeks w, sel WHERE w.week_start IN (sel.wk, date(sel.wk, '-7 days')) ORDER BY w.week_start

SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', w.week_start) AS INTEGER) AS time, w.bypass_lookups AS "Encrypted DNS"

targets.rawQueryText:

panels.title: Day by day
panels.description: Queries per day of the selected week (Asia/Kolkata days).

targets.queryText:
WITH sel AS (SELECT (SELECT CASE '$week' WHEN 'last' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks WHERE complete = 1) WHEN 'current' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks) ELSE '$week' END) AS wk)
SELECT substr('SunMonTueWedThuFriSat', 1 + 3 * CAST(strftime('%w', day) AS INTEGER), 3) || ' ' || CAST(strftime('%d', day) AS INTEGER) AS "Day", queries - blocked AS "Allowed", blocked AS "Blocked"
FROM days, sel WHERE days.week_start = sel.wk ORDER BY day
targets.rawQueryText:
WITH sel AS (SELECT (SELECT CASE '$week' WHEN 'last' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks WHERE complete = 1) WHEN 'current' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks) ELSE '$week' END) AS wk)
SELECT substr('SunMonTueWedThuFriSat', 1 + 3 * CAST(strftime('%w', day) AS INTEGER), 3) || ' ' || CAST(strftime('%d', day) AS INTEGER) AS "Day", queries - blocked AS "Allowed", blocked AS "Blocked"
FROM days, sel WHERE days.week_start = sel.wk ORDER BY day

panels.title: Week by week
panels.description: Every week in the digest. Pi-hole itself keeps 91 days; the digest keeps older weeks.

targets.queryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%d', week_start) AS INTEGER) || ' ' || substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', 1 + 3 * (CAST(strftime('%m', week_start) AS INTEGER) - 1), 3) || CASE complete WHEN 1 THEN '' ELSE ' (so far)' END AS "Week of", queries - blocked AS "Allowed", blocked AS "Blocked"
FROM weeks ORDER BY week_start
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%d', week_start) AS INTEGER) || ' ' || substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', 1 + 3 * (CAST(strftime('%m', week_start) AS INTEGER) - 1), 3) || CASE complete WHEN 1 THEN '' ELSE ' (so far)' END AS "Week of", queries - blocked AS "Allowed", blocked AS "Blocked"
FROM weeks ORDER BY week_start

panels.title: Top blocked
panels.description: Most-blocked domains. The router's health checks (www.belkin.com and two reverse lookups) are left out of every top list but counted in the totals.

targets.queryText:
WITH sel AS (SELECT (SELECT CASE '$week' WHEN 'last' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks WHERE complete = 1) WHEN 'current' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks) ELSE '$week' END) AS wk)
SELECT rank AS "#", domain AS "Domain", queries AS "Blocked", clients AS "Devices"
FROM top_domains, sel WHERE week_start = sel.wk AND kind = 'blocked' ORDER BY rank
targets.rawQueryText:
WITH sel AS (SELECT (SELECT CASE '$week' WHEN 'last' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks WHERE complete = 1) WHEN 'current' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks) ELSE '$week' END) AS wk)

FROM top_domains, sel WHERE week_start = sel.wk AND kind = 'blocked' ORDER BY rank

panels.title: New this week
panels.description: Sites first seen this week (not in the four weeks before), busiest first, top 40. Worth a glance for new apps, devices or trackers. Reverse lookups are left out.

panels.title: Devices
panels.description: Who asked. Until the router hands out Pi-hole (192.168.0.10) as the DNS server, every device on the Wi-Fi shows up as the router, LinksysMX5500.

targets.queryText:
WITH sel AS (SELECT (SELECT CASE '$week' WHEN 'last' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks WHERE complete = 1) WHEN 'current' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks) ELSE '$week' END) AS wk)
SELECT name AS "Device", ip AS "Address", queries AS "Queries", blocked AS "Blocked", pct_blocked AS "Blocked %"
FROM clients, sel WHERE week_start = sel.wk ORDER BY rank
targets.rawQueryText:
WITH sel AS (SELECT (SELECT CASE '$week' WHEN 'last' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks WHERE complete = 1) WHEN 'current' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks) ELSE '$week' END) AS wk)

panels.title: Encrypted DNS and relay lookups
panels.description: Encrypted DNS resolver: a browser or phone (Secure DNS, Android Private DNS) looking up a DoH/DoT server; once connected it bypasses Pi-hole. iCloud Private Relay: Pi-hole answers mask.icloud.com with NXDOMAIN so Apple devices fall back to normal DNS. Firefox DoH check: Pi-hole's answer tells Firefox not to switch on DoH. Blocked = answered by Pi-hole's blocking.

targets.queryText:
WITH sel AS (SELECT (SELECT CASE '$week' WHEN 'last' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks WHERE complete = 1) WHEN 'current' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks) ELSE '$week' END) AS wk)
SELECT name AS "Device", ip AS "Address", kind AS "Kind", domain AS "Name looked up", queries AS "Lookups", blocked AS "Blocked"
FROM bypass, sel WHERE week_start = sel.wk ORDER BY queries DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
WITH sel AS (SELECT (SELECT CASE '$week' WHEN 'last' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks WHERE complete = 1) WHEN 'current' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks) ELSE '$week' END) AS wk)
SELECT name AS "Device", ip AS "Address", kind AS "Kind", domain AS "Name looked up", queries AS "Lookups", blocked AS "Blocked"
FROM bypass, sel WHERE week_start = sel.wk ORDER BY queries DESC

panels.title: LAN reverse lookups sent upstream
panels.description: Reverse (PTR) lookups of private addresses that went to the public upstream. Pi-hole answers them locally when bogusPriv is on, or asks the router with conditional forwarding.

targets.queryText:
WITH sel AS (SELECT (SELECT CASE '$week' WHEN 'last' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks WHERE complete = 1) WHEN 'current' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks) ELSE '$week' END) AS wk)
SELECT name AS "Device", ip AS "Address", queries AS "Lookups", addresses AS "Addresses"
FROM ptr_upstream, sel WHERE week_start = sel.wk ORDER BY queries DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
WITH sel AS (SELECT (SELECT CASE '$week' WHEN 'last' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks WHERE complete = 1) WHEN 'current' THEN (SELECT max(week_start) FROM weeks) ELSE '$week' END) AS wk)
SELECT name AS "Device", ip AS "Address", queries AS "Lookups", addresses AS "Addresses"
FROM ptr_upstream, sel WHERE week_start = sel.wk ORDER BY queries DESC

panels.title: Blocklists (as of the last digest run)
Lists
panels.description: Enabled adlists, their size and how the weekly gravity update (Sunday 03:16) went. Changed is when the list's content last changed.

targets.queryText:
SELECT address AS "List", comment AS "Comment", domains AS "Domains", invalid AS "Invalid lines", status AS "Last refresh", updated AS "Changed"
FROM lists WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY domains DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT address AS "List", comment AS "Comment", domains AS "Domains", invalid AS "Invalid lines", status AS "Last refresh", updated AS "Changed"
FROM lists WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY domains DESC

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) AS "Blocked domains" FROM meta WHERE key = 'gravity_domains'
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) AS "Blocked domains" FROM meta WHERE key = 'gravity_domains'

panels.title: Digest updated
panels.description: When pihole_digest.py last ran (cron, daily at 05:10).

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', value) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS "Digest updated" FROM meta WHERE key = 'updated_at'
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', value) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS "Digest updated" FROM meta WHERE key = 'updated_at'
